column1: # Functions listed here are excluded from lizard threshold enforcement.
# Each entry must be justified by a documented design decision.
# These are large switch-based protocol command dispatchers whose CCN is driven
# entirely by the number of supported commands (40+ cases).  Reducing CCN below
# the 15 threshold would require a function-pointer dispatch table
# architectural change deferred to a future refactor.  Each case body is simple
# XO2ECA_apiProgram implements the Lattice ECA JEDEC-programming state machine.
# The CCN reflects the number of distinct hardware states and error paths
# logical branches that can be simplified.  Deviation tracked in design docs.
# main() is a sequential initialisation + super-loop; its length (>100 NLOC)
# MX_GPIO_Init is auto-generated by STM32CubeMX.  Its length (>100 NLOC)
# comes from the number of GPIO pins configured
